value.rationale: This canonical smallest four-chromatic triangle-free four-regular graph has a natural but previously unreported optimal edge-sensing mobility classification. All 192 optima remain mutually reachable even under strict single-edge sliding, while maximal relocation distance grows from five to seven and the complete local degree distribution is nonuniform. Connectivity and robustness of optimal landmarks are mathematically motivated and not routine consequences of graph coloring.
